data.title: 只告诉你的天台秘密
data.location: 学院教学楼天台铁网边
data.camera: 铁丝网前景过肩斜角中景
data.prompt: 1girl, solo, ayachi_nene, nene_school_uniform, navy blazer, yellow bowtie, grey plaid skirt, leaning against chain-link fence, hand on fence, windblown hair, looking at viewer, fond smile, slight blush, rooftop, wire fence foreground, orange sky, dramatic clouds, warm rim light, long shadows, dutch angle, medium shot
data.animaCaption: Resting one shoulder against the rooftop fence while the evening wind lifts her hair across her cheek, she tilts her head close and smiles as if sharing a secret only you may hear. Warm orange sunset light carves bright gold along the wire mesh and her silver strands.
data.promptProse: Shot at a slight diagonal angle with the metal diamonds of a rooftop chain-link fence framing the near edge, Ayachi Nene leans back against the railing in her navy blazer and yellow bowtie. One hand hooks lightly into the wire mesh while her other hand tucks windblown strands of silver hair behind her ear, her purple eyes fixed softly on the viewer with an unguarded smile. Beyond the fence, a vast autumn sunset burns amber and violet across drifting clouds, sending warm rim light along her profile and stretching long shadows across the weathered concrete floor.
data.story: 放学后的天台吹着微凉的晚风。宁宁背靠在被夕阳烤暖的铁丝网边，伸手按住吹乱的发梢，把那句藏了很久的心事轻声说出口——「其实啊，以前我总觉得保守秘密很孤单……现在却有点庆幸，撞破它的人是你。」
